_readme: One object per client tile. A client that returns in a later semester keeps ONE tile with several 'engagements' (newest shown on the card); parallel projects for the same client in the same semester are separate tiles. Each engagement: semester (e.g. 'Fall 2025'), optional title, tagline (the card's Objective), challenge, scope (list), optional scope_detail/approach, skills, outcome (null until known). Tile fields: id, title, client, optional short_name, client_type, featured, disciplines, fits (inferred mapping of majors/interests; fit_inferred: true until officers confirm), team, links, logo (path; may omit the extension, e.g. assets/logos/hyswaplogo, and any .png/.jpg/.svg with that name is used), logo_bg (tile color; sampled automatically from the logo if omitted), logo_offset. Fields that are null or empty are omitted on the live site. No individual contact names, emails, fees or payment terms.

projects.title: Alliom
projects.summary: Alliom aims to develop machine learning models that address inefficiencies in the stratified housing market by predicting property values at a granular level (for example, by zip code).

engagements.tagline: Predicting housing values at the zip-code level with machine learning.
engagements.challenge: The housing market is stratified, and broad averages hide what is happening in specific neighborhoods. Alliom wants models that predict property values at a much finer level.
engagements.scope_detail: The project refines two forecasting models (a time-series model and an LSTM), brings in professionals for technical guidance, and develops business strategies for monetization and legal compliance.
engagements.approach: [TBD: how the team actually worked, tools, methods, cadence]

projects.title: School Harbor
projects.summary: The project replicates an existing Tableau dashboard that visualizes student test scores over time, segmented by demographics and aggregated at school-district and state levels.
projects.repeat_client_note: School Harbor appears more than once in the old site's past-client list. If it is a repeat client, say so (confirm first).

engagements.title: Colorado school data API
engagements.tagline: Building a queryable database and public API for Colorado school data
engagements.challenge: School Harbor had partial address and school ID data but no centralized, authoritative, easy-to-update source. Reflecting school closures, openings and moves required manual work.
scope: Normalized relational database for school, address and ID records
Python ETL pipeline to clean, load and annually update Colorado Department of Education data
REST API with endpoints to query by school name, address, year and ID
Documentation, setup guide and a version-controlled GitHub repository

engagements.tagline: Rebuilding a student test-score dashboard on a cloud SQL database and Looker Studio.
engagements.challenge: School Harbor needed its student test-score reporting reproduced in a different toolchain while keeping the same level of detail: scores over time, split by demographics, rolled up to district and state.
engagements.scope_detail: Data is managed in a Google SQL database and visualized in Google Looker Studio to give a Tableau-like experience. The work includes configuring the database, connecting it to Looker Studio, and potentially using Python for sub-tasks.
engagements.approach: [TBD: how the team actually worked, tools, methods, cadence]

projects.title: Product Space
projects.summary: Product Space gives UMD students a way to explore product design, apply their skills on real-world projects, and build a professional network. As a new organization with a 5-member board and an inaugural cohort of 9 members, it needed support streamlining client outreach, benchmarking best practices, and planning for growth and turnover.

engagements.tagline: Helping a brand-new product-design org scale its outreach and plan for turnover.
engagements.challenge: A new organization needs repeatable processes before it grows: how to reach clients, what good looks like elsewhere, and how to hand off smoothly as leaders graduate.
engagements.scope_detail: The team built an outreach process, benchmarked best practices from comparable organizations, and documented a timeline and process flow to manage growth and turnover.
engagements.approach: [TBD: how the team actually worked, tools, methods, cadence]

projects.title: UMD Dynamic Dance
projects.summary: UMD Dynamic Dance is a hip-hop dance team with 25 members and a 7-8 member E-Board. It asked for support improving administrative efficiency, knowledge management and marketing.

engagements.tagline: Operations, knowledge management and marketing for a 25-member hip-hop dance team.
engagements.challenge: A busy, growing team needs clear roles, documentation that survives leadership changes, and a marketing approach that strengthens its campus presence and external outreach.
engagements.scope_detail: The project focuses on role delegation, streamlining documentation and communication processes, and refining the team's marketing approach.
engagements.approach: [TBD: how the team actually worked, tools, methods, cadence]

projects.title: SCG Internal Project
projects.summary: An internal SCG project addressing member engagement, performance quality and operational efficiency.

engagements.title: Donation process and Snider Center strategy
engagements.tagline: Designing a sustainable donation process and assessing SCG's relationship with the Snider Center
engagements.challenge: SCG needed a clear, sustainable way to receive donations for project work, and a better understanding of how it can work with the Ed Snider Center and its business network.
scope: Donation strategy: develop an approach, pitch it to club leadership and implement it
Snider Center assessment: a framework for its status and impact within the Smith School, UMD and society
Opportunity scan for speakers, projects and internships through the Center's network
Recommendations and action items for club leadership

engagements.tagline: Turning the lens on ourselves: engagement, quality and operations.
engagements.challenge: Improve how senior members stay involved, raise the quality of work and presentations, and streamline internal procedures across recruitment, onboarding and client acquisition.
engagements.scope_detail: The team identifies solutions for senior-member involvement, work and presentation quality, and internal procedures from recruitment through client acquisition.
engagements.approach: [TBD: how the team actually worked, tools, methods, cadence]

engagements.tagline: Growing community outreach and volunteer leadership for a local sustainability exchange
engagements.challenge: Hy-Swap runs local item-exchange events that reduce waste. Since the pandemic, community engagement patterns have shifted, and the organization relies on traditional marketing and an overextended core leadership team.
scope: Volunteer engagement and leadership pipeline plan

engagements.tagline: Building sustainable operations and funding for UMD's collegiate wind energy team
engagements.challenge: A student-led team of 20-30 members competing in the U.S. Department of Energy's Collegiate Wind Competition faces member retention, subteam communication and fundraising gaps, and depends heavily on the national competition for engagement.
scope: Internal organization toolkit covering task delegation, subteam roles and project tracking
Recruitment and retention strategy, including bridging the VIP course with club participation
Sponsorship and fundraising packet with tiers, a pitch template and a partner list

engagements.tagline: Building leadership structure and funding for a fast-growing student organization
engagements.challenge: Business Beyond Borders creates business opportunities for refugees, immigrants and underrepresented students. As a rapidly growing organization it needed clearer leadership roles, stronger knowledge transfer and systems for sustainable growth.
scope: Leadership framework, E-Board responsibilities and a semester-to-semester transition guide
Semester event timeline with frameworks for philanthropy, mentoring, fundraising and awareness events
Corporate sponsorship strategy with a contact list and resource packets

engagements.tagline: Expanding distribution and engagement for an AI-powered public-speaking platform
engagements.challenge: SpeechPundit gives users near-instant AI feedback on public speaking, but has limited institutional partnerships and few features that encourage ongoing engagement.
scope: University career-services pilot with outreach, a student trial and an adoption report
B2B activation strategy piloted through an industry association in construction
User experience and product opportunity brief based on hands-on use of the platform
Dual-track growth plan comparing nonprofit and corporate pathways

engagements.tagline: Building a five-year financial plan and pricing strategy for a school-safety startup
engagements.challenge: DefenX is a student-founded UMD startup that built an AI-powered system to detect visible guns in schools and alert staff and security in real time, and winner of the inaugural Xperience Competition. This project focused on its finances.

engagements.tagline: Planning a two-year outreach strategy to scale a school-safety startup nationally
engagements.challenge: The second part of DefenX's scope focused on reaching customers: targeting specific counties, districts and schools based on current regulations, in support of scaling across the U.S. within the next three to four years.

engagements.tagline: Opening fundraising channels and organizing events for UMD's competitive debate team
engagements.challenge: The Maryland Parliamentary Debate Society competes nationally in the American Parliamentary Debate Association and hosts bi-annual tournaments at UMD. It wanted new fundraising channels and more organized transitions, scheduling and event practices.
scope: Fundraising guide covering sponsorships, donations and partnerships with high school academies

engagements.tagline: Strengthening funding, social media and transitions for UMD's undergraduate legal journal
engagements.challenge: Re-established in 2024, the Undergraduate Law Review is the only legal journal on campus. It needed more fundraising streams, a clearer social media structure and sustainable transition documents so the club continues after current leadership graduates.
scope: Social media timeline and content guide

engagements.tagline: Expanding the reach and prestige of UMD's student equity research club
engagements.challenge: Smith Equity Research teaches analysts fundamental analysis and publishes a club-wide equity report each semester. The goal of this project was to expand the club's reach and prestige.

engagements.tagline: Improving member retention and engagement for UMD's FBLA chapter
engagements.challenge: UMD's FBLA chapter runs guest speakers, workshops and semester-long group projects. This project focused on member retention and engagement through better organization and a stronger value proposition for members.
scope: Organization strategy guide covering onboarding, task tracking and processes
